objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving processes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code identifier for the document

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as Editing, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date marking the start of the document's validity period

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date marking the end of the document's validity period

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual substance or body of the document

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The areas, companies, or organizational units to which the document applies

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, Master data, or related objects

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Relevant IT systems associated with the document

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person in the organization who interacts with documents in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The function or responsibility assigned to the user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: The group membership determining access rights and workflow participation

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned collectively to documents for authorization, notification, and workflow purposes.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, or Distribution group

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement that is released with the main document and triggers versioning of the main document upon modification.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release status of the attachment aligned with main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A non-controlled supplement to a document that does not affect the main document's version or release cycle.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process flow for document approval consisting of steps such as Creator, Review, and Release with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The current or defined stage in the approval process

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User assigned to complete a workflow step

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature documenting completion of a workflow step

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A planned modification to an existing document that is managed separately without affecting the document's version history until implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the change proposal such as Created, Scheduled, or Completed

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: When the change proposal is scheduled to be incorporated

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manual request to check and extend the validity period of a document at defined intervals.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: State of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity or is no longer required.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: State of the override request

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: User who created the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document during its archiving period.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: State of the reactivation request

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of users and user groups designated to receive documents and participate in notification or acknowledgement workflows.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type such as Email Notification or Acknowledgement Required

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: User or user group on the distribution list

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group that retains read access to archived documents when other authorizations are revoked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which documents remain archived before physical deletion

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure with metadata fields and formatting for a specific document type.

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Associated document type

attributes.name: default_fields
attributes.description: Metadata fields automatically populated using TAG technology

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation action by a recipient that they have reviewed and understood a distributed document.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date and time when acknowledgement was confirmed

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object to the system with selection of document type and optional template for initial document creation.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or properties including metadata maintenance and attribute updates.

evts.name: upload_content
evts.description: Attachment of external files or documents to a document object or generation of new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system-supported conversion of document content to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related authorizations to a document including reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser roles.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document supplement that is released with the main document and triggers versioning.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of a non-controlled supplement to a document that does not affect version or release cycle.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a planned modification to an existing document managed separately without affecting version history until implementation.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Scheduling of a change proposal for implementation which creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completion of editing on a change proposal with notification to the proposal creator.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start of the 3-step workflow process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps for document approval.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature action by workflow participants to document completion of a workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Checking of document content according to technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewer.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by assigned releaser allowing visibility to readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of a new version of a valid and released document with retention of previous version data.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachments for archiving when no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language by assigned translator.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated or manual request to check and extend validity period of a document at defined intervals.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of additional validity for a document with update of the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of override request resulting in invalidation and archiving of a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declaration of document status as Out of Force with revocation of all authorizations except for archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of a request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document during archiving period.

evts.name: process_reactivation_request
evts.description: Approval of reactivation request resulting in creation of new version with restored metadata and properties.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notification of directly assigned users and user groups by email when new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow-supported request for recipients to actively confirm acknowledgement of distributed document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirmation action documenting that they have reviewed and understood a distributed document.

evts.name: translate_release_process
evts.description: Workflow-supported checking and releasing of translated document version with signature by translator participants.
